sentences.text: This review covers wellbore 15/9-F-4 on the Volve field, a production well in the 15/9-F drilling cluster.
No data tools were available when this review was written, so no depths, dates, hole sizes, durations, rates or volumes are stated here.
Every figure for this wellbore has to be taken from the field data and checked before the review is issued.
The section-by-section record for 15/9-F-4 (hole sizes, start and end depths, casing shoes and new hole drilled) is not reproduced in this draft.
Each section should be compared against the planned casing design and the actual casing points once the data is loaded.
The split between drilling activity and lost time for the well, by section and by tier, is not quantified in this draft.
Lost-time causes should be grouped by code once the activity records are available, so that the largest contributors are identified.
The campaign structure, operation phases and reporting coverage of the well are not described in this draft.
Gaps in daily reporting and any before-spud or flagged reports should be reviewed before the reporting record is relied on.
Populate the hole-section table, the time breakdown and the campaign summary from the field data.
Re-issue this review with all quantities attached as checked claims.
